description: This file defines the KinesisClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, which provides methods to interact with the Amazon Kinesis streaming service.

classes.name: KinesisClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with Amazon Kinesis, extending AwsClient.

methods.name: addTagsToStream
methods.description: Adds tags to a Kinesis data stream.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a new Kinesis data stream.

methods.name: decreaseStreamRetentionPeriod
methods.description: Decreases the retention period of a Kinesis data stream.

methods.name: deleteResourcePolicy
methods.description: Deletes a resource policy attached to a stream.

methods.name: deleteStream
methods.description: Deletes a data stream.

methods.name: deregisterStreamConsumer
methods.description: Deregisters a stream consumer.

methods.name: describeLimits
methods.description: Describes the limits for Kinesis streams.

methods.name: describeStream
methods.description: Describes the specified stream.

methods.name: describeStreamConsumer
methods.description: Provides details about a stream consumer.

methods.name: describeStreamSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of the specified stream.

methods.name: disableEnhancedMonitoring
methods.description: Disables enhanced monitoring for a stream.

methods.name: enableEnhancedMonitoring
methods.description: Enables enhanced monitoring for a stream.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description: Retrieves data records from a stream.

methods.name: getResourcePolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the resource policy for a stream.

methods.name: getShardIterator
methods.description: Gets a shard iterator for reading data from a stream.

methods.name: increaseStreamRetentionPeriod
methods.description: Increases the retention period of a stream.

methods.name: listShards
methods.description: Lists the shards in a stream.

methods.name: listStreamConsumers
methods.description: Lists the consumers of a stream.

methods.name: listStreams
methods.description: Lists all streams.

methods.name: listTagsForStream
methods.description: Lists tags for a stream.

methods.name: mergeShards
methods.description: Merges two adjacent shards.

methods.name: putRecord
methods.description: Puts a single data record into a stream.

methods.name: putRecords
methods.description: Puts multiple data records into a stream.

methods.name: putResourcePolicy
methods.description: Attaches a resource policy to a stream.

methods.name: registerStreamConsumer
methods.description: Registers a stream consumer.

methods.name: removeTagsFromStream
methods.description: Removes tags from a stream.

methods.name: splitShard
methods.description: Splits a shard into two shards.

methods.name: startStreamEncryption
methods.description: Starts stream encryption.

methods.name: stopStreamEncryption
methods.description: Stops stream encryption.

methods.name: updateShardCount
methods.description: Updates the shard count of a stream.

methods.name: updateStreamMode
methods.description: Updates the streaming mode.
